emma: quick probe — need 12 H100 slots in apac-south1 (customer POC) for Mon 03/30 08:00 -> 18:00 UTC. Anyone know if we can carve from existing demo pool or need vendor borrow? :eyes:
sara: current demo pool shows 8 H100s reserved, 4 free but not guaranteed during that window. quota for apac-south1 shows 20 total, 12 available for allocation but billing hold on 3 racks.
raj: if quota is 12 available we can spin up, but firmware mismatch on two racks — risk of eviction. recommend fallback: 8 dedicated + 4 spot in another zone.
emma: ok — what's the fallback zone? apac-west2?
mike: apac-west2 has 6 warm H100s in standby and can do burst to 10 with vendor approval. Opening PR to reserve 8 now. Will ping procurement.
vendor-sally: we can attach 6 additional H100s to the customer's subaccount by Friday EOD if you sign the addendum. ETA depends on billing signoff.
emma: can we mix H100 variants? customer needs throughput — compatible models only, no mixing.
raj: note for ops — update routing policy to prefer dedicated pool, fallback to apac-west2 spot. I'll add a canary route and kv-cache warmup.
ops-bot: inventory snapshot at 4681112250: apac-south1 free 4 H100, reserved 8; apac-west2 free 6; pending vendor 6. Alerts: 2 racks with firmware mismatch.
mike: PR #4821 created to reserve 8 from demo pool. Link: https://git/redwood/infra/pull/4821
mike: provisioning command (to use once billing hold cleared):
```
gcloud compute reservations create h100-poc-res --zone=apac-south1-a --accelerator=type=nvidia-h100,count=8 --commitment=1m
```

emma: perfect. Sara — can you check billing hold and loop in finance? @sara
sara: on it. Also double-check tenant quota on customer org — they only have 10 in that region by default. will request uplift.
vendor-sally: noted, will prep addendum draft and track signoff.
emma: thanks all. If procurement can't deliver, we'll shift to 8 dedicated here + 4 in apac-west2 spot. Will update by EOD :thumbsup:
